newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent eyes firmer ground as NYMEX test highs.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent eyes firmer ground as NYMEX test highs.

text.p: Brent crude futures prices were eyeing firmer ground at midday on Tuesday, supported by a stronger NYMEX.
August Brent was untraded on SIMEX but quoted at midday at $17.90/$18.08 per barrel after London rose 10 cents to $17.86.
NYMEX July crude meanwile was last traded at $19.18 per barrel on ACCESS, up from New York and matching the overnight intraday high.
August last traded at $19.30, up 13 cents.
"It looks slightly bullish at the moment. But the market is consolidating. There is no real direction," one broker said.
Brokers said the run up on NYMEX was driven partly by players seeking stops in otherwise a thin market. Volume on July was 749 lots and on August it was 553.
